The City of Sammamish has started to work on the fish passage barrier assessment and prioritization project. This science-based project is a partnership with Wild Fish Conservancy to inventory, assess, and prioritize fish passage barriers within the City.

[Update on Ziply Fiber Right-of-Way Permits](https://www.sammamish.us/news/update-on-ziply-fiber-right-of-way-permits/)
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

September 10, 2025

The City has been working with Ziply Fiber representatives since the January 23, 2025 suspension of Right-of-Way (ROW) permits to address and resolve issues that occurred during the installation of underground high-speed fiber internet lines.

We continue to work closely with Ziply to ensure their construction meets City standards and expectations before reissuing permits. Most of the related work is located along 228th Avenue Northeast, from Northeast 8th Street to Northeast 28th Place.

Additional project details available on the [Sammamish Cone Zone webpage](https://www.sammamish.us/news/cone-zone-8-22-25-sammamish-traffic-updates/).
